'''Utterance of Marvels: II''' is the second part in the [[Prologue]] chapter of the [[Main Quests]].

== Synopsis ==
[[Baizhi]], [[Chixia]], and [[Yangyang]] lead [[Rover]] to [[Jinzhou]]. On their way there, Chixia helps Rover properly absorb an [[Echo]] with their [[terminal]]. Once at Jinzhou, the trio split up, and Rover is left in Chixia’s care as they explore the city together before meeting the [[Jinhsi|Magistrate]].

==Steps==
#Find a suitable [[Tacet Discord]]
#Defeat [[Stonewall Bracer]]
#Absorb the Reverberation and obtain an [[Echo]]
#Equip the Echo
#Defeat nearby TDs: (0/2)
#Return to [[Jinzhou]]
##(Optional) Activate [[Resonance Beacon]]
#Head to Jinzhou

==Gameplay Notes==
* Completing the quest will grant the ''[[Rover's Journey]]'' [[trophy]] ''[[From the New World]]'' and the [[Resonator]] [[Chixia]].

::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_1_29.ogg}} '''Baizhi:''' The unique nature of your condition requires specialized treatment only available in the Huaxu Academy.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_1_30.ogg}} '''Baizhi:''' And your body is bound to arouse the interest of many researchers.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_1_31.ogg}} '''Baizhi:''' Myself included.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_1_32.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Baizhi, I think your last sentence could be worded better...
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_1_33.ogg}} '''Baizhi:''' I see. I agree that my phrasing lacked the attention to detail. Please allow me to reorganize my words.

:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_1_34.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' You guys done yet?
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_1_35.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' What's the hold up. Let's move, then I'll have more time to show Rover around!
